title: Clairambault 1067
contents: Brienne advises delaying replies about the government of Nivernais, so continued possession may strengthen the claim. He also reports French and Dutch military preparations and Prince Thomas’s embarkation for an Italian expedition.
fields: 88 symbols/codes, 25 letter signs, 61 in nomenclature, 2 nulls
Historical plaintext above cipher rows on PDF50–53, ff226–227 and continuation; letter ends at PDF55.

excerpt: Le mien a esté qu’en la pluspart des affaires du monde le souverain conseil est de gaigner temps, et que ce seroit **assez tost respondre aux ministres de Monsieur de Mantoue quand ilz renouvelleroient leurs instances**; et peut estre qu’ayant presentement diverses choses à poursuivre ilz pourront **s’oublier de celle-là, et ainsi le titre du gouvernement de Nivernois se trouvera fortiffié d’une possession maintenue depuis son absence du Royaume**.
translation: My view was that in most affairs of the world the wisest course is to gain time, and that it would be soon enough to answer Monsieur de Mantua’s ministers when they renewed their requests. Perhaps, having various matters to pursue at present, they will forget this one; thus the title to the government of Nivernois will be strengthened by possession maintained since his departure from the kingdom.
